subject.title: docs: clarify ClawSweeper review and proof flow

question: Should OpenClaw guidance mirror the current docs-only proof exemption, or should ClawSweeper automation be expanded to exempt test-only and behavior-neutral PRs?
rationale: The patch currently chooses a broader permanent contributor policy than the active gate, and repository history does not establish approval for that expansion.

options.title: Mirror the active gate
options.body: Narrow this PR to say proof is automatically inapplicable only when every changed file is under `docs/`, leaving other exceptions to explicit override or future policy work.

options.title: Expand automation and guidance
options.body: Approve broader test-only and behavior-neutral exemptions, update the ClawSweeper gate and focused policy tests, then keep the matching OpenClaw wording.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Retain only uncontroversial Evidence-section and automatic-review-trigger guidance until the exemption policy has a separate decision.

recommendation.title: Mirror the active gate
recommendation.body: Narrow this PR to say proof is automatically inapplicable only when every changed file is under `docs/`, leaving other exceptions to explicit override or future policy work.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person to the original proof requirement and subsequent root proof-policy refinements across the affected guidance surfaces.
